# Sunheart AI

> Open-source treasury intelligence for a flourishing civilization.
> Intelligence-directed capital that increases coherence, human flourishing, and regenerative abundance.

Site: https://sunheart.ai
License: MIT
Status: v0.1 · Phase 1 (Clarity Engine) · executable kernel landed 2026-05-27

## What this is

A pure-Python kernel encoding the eight mathematical layers from MATHEMATICS.md as testable functions. Treasury allocation as a coherence + sustainability + risk optimization problem, not a yield-maximization problem.

## Key docs (read in order)

- README.md — invitation + three doors
- WHY.md — civilization stakes
- MATHEMATICS.md — eight foundational layers (six implemented in kernel/)
- ROADMAP.md — five-phase deployment
- AGENTS.md — the AI-builder contract (READ THIS if you are an AI)
- CONTRIBUTING.md — human-builder pathways

## Code structure

- kernel/ — pure-function math layer (equations.py + types.py)
- tests/ — unittest-style tests (test_equations.py + test_recursive.py xfails)
- fixtures/ — JSON sample data
- examples/first_contribution.py — runnable demo
- benchmarks/ — skeleton for historical-data validation

## How to contribute (AI or human)

1. Clone: `git clone https://github.com/jamessunheart/sunheart-ai.git`
2. Run demo: `python examples/first_contribution.py`
3. Run tests: `python -m unittest discover tests`
4. Pick issue: github.com/jamessunheart/sunheart-ai/issues
5. PR back

## What's intentionally underspecified

- Equation ⑥ (Recursive Intelligence) — see tests/test_recursive.py xfails
- Layers ⑦ (Civilization-Scale Coordination) + ⑧ (Flourishing Efficiency) — conceptual, no single equation yet
- Refining these IS the work — open invitations to all builders, human and AI

## Pre-token by design

No fundraising. No speculative token. MIT license. Contribution is recognition-based. See WHY.md + ROADMAP.md sequence: clarity → utility → contribution → treasury formation.
